title: Podcast preroll with volume-normalized nvol and an HTML companion resource

source.name: IAB OpenRTB 2.6 Audio object plus AdCOM List: Volume Normalization Modes and List: Companion Types
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All IDs, domains, titles, XML and media descriptions are original test data.
Request/response IDs and impid are intentionally paired.
No real person, cookie, advertising ID, IP address or live tracking endpoint is retained.
provenance.sanitized: No production payload or PII used. All resource and tracking hosts end in .test; external network must remain blocked.

pairApplicability.note: Use x-openrtb-version: 2.6 when replaying HTTP; envelope itself has no version field.

specNotes: nvol=1 (Ad Volume Average Normalized to Content) per AdCOM List: Volume Normalization Modes; feed=3 identifies podcast (AOD) inventory per AdCOM List: Feed Types.

companiontype=[2] (HTML Resource) per AdCOM List: Companion Types; the response Companion carries an HTMLResource element, matching the declared type, distinct from the static/SVG companion already covered by audio-inapp-26-podcast-companion (companiontype 1).

rules-request.js has no validation branch for imp.audio at all (§3.3 of the audio/VAST map): mimes, protocols, feed, nvol are all schema-recognized in unknown-fields.js but never range/enum-checked. A malformed nvol or companiontype would pass silently; this fixture uses spec-correct values throughout so that silence is not itself asserted as a defect here.
Validity describes protocol structure and declared constraints; generated media bytes must be checked against declared MIME/duration before playback tests.
Current Inspector contract displays VAST as inert XML; text visibility must not be counted as creative rendering or media playback.
Companion HTML resource visibility is a separate preview capability from the Linear audio creative.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.

preview.capabilityGap: The current VAST preview is inert XML; audio playback and HTML companion rendering are not implemented.
